meta_data.base_class: retrieve the historical population size of a specific animal species in a given <country> - each country has independent ecological and data systems but shares the same query structure.

tool_template.name: animal_population.get_<class>_history
tool_template.description: Retrieve historical population size of a specific species in <class>.

species.description: Species of the animal for which the historical population size is requested in <class>.

years.description: Number of years of historical data to retrieve.

data_source.description: The preferred data source for retrieving historical population data of the species in <class>.

granularity.description: The level of detail in the historical data, being 'national', 'regional', or 'local', when retrieving species population size in <class>.

confidence_interval.description: The confidence interval to apply to the species population estimates in <class>, expressed as a percentage.

output_format.description: The desired output format of the species population history data in <class>, being 'json', 'csv', or 'xml'.

time_interval.description: The time interval for data aggregation, being 'monthly', 'quarterly', or 'yearly', for the species historical population data in <country>.
